_comment: Canonical WebAuthn client response wire shapes. WebAuthnAttestationResponse is the client response for registration verification. WebAuthnAssertionResponse is the client response for authentication verification. Serialized from WebAuthnAttestationResponse and WebAuthnAssertionResponse (internal/models/webauthn.go).

webauthn_attestation_response._description: Client response for WebAuthn registration verification.

transports.description: Authenticator transport methods. Omitted when empty. Values: usb, nfc, internal, hybrid.

webauthn_assertion_response._description: Client response for WebAuthn authentication verification.

userHandle.description: User handle (base64url-encoded). Omitted when not provided.
